meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会逐个通读代码库里的每一个源码文件,大文件用 Read 工具分页读完,以此建立对代码库的理解。
howto.when: 开始新项目或不熟悉的项目时,或你提到 “learn the codebase”、“prime” 等说法时触发。

say.note: 会逐文件通读全部源码

say.text: 先通读这个项目的所有源码,再开始改

howto.what_en: After install, Claude reads every source file in full, paging through large files with the Read tool, to build an understanding of the codebase.
howto.when_en: When starting on a new or unfamiliar project, or when you say things like "learn the codebase", "prime", etc.

say_en.note: Reads every source file in full

say_en.text: Read all the source in this project before changing it

say_en.note: Large files are read in pages
